metric_note: s_i = 1 if the task's eval_res.json has pass == true, else 0 (0/1, no partial credit); with several runs per task, s_i is the mean over runs.
weighting: score = sum(w_i * s_i); weights normalised so sum(w_i) == 1

upstream.dataset: original 108-task release (pre-Verified); correctness records from HF Toolathlon-Trajectories
upstream.task_filter_flag: --task_list <txt> — one task name per line, i.e. the 'tasks toolathlon --format ids' output
